mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate level signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days regardless of the current economic cycle.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 3.0% (using rolling 3-month average).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals weakening labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a broad-based demand contraction that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 195) with restrictive monetary policy (FEDFUNDS > 3.0%), the central bank's focus on inflation control leads to reduced equity valuations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation and restrictive monetary policy
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 195 and FEDFUNDS > 3.0.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level below 2000 thousand units signals weak residential construction and reduced economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST is below 2000.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), the labor market weakness reduces consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and real GDP (GDPC1) signal a broad economic contraction that triggers equity market declines, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline.

mechanism_narrative: A high consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) level signals persistent inflation that erodes real corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of the current economic cycle.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL is above 195.
